headAttestation.note: sourceBase remains the repository-wide historical identity shared by all module maps. candidateHead/candidateTree attest the frozen current-main convergence candidate before metadata-only attestation commits. Only this implementation map and the module-scoped final-verification receipt may change after that candidate without invalidating the attestation. The dedicated qualification workflow now pins exact source-head identity, resolves the current remote-tracking main head at execution time, and constructs the repository-standard deterministic two-parent synthetic merge, then runs the same federation/product Rust suite on both identities. The candidate enforces ordered query-bound response integrity, Partial+[] preservation, live pre/post-I/O authority, interruptible single-attempt transport, exact-scope same-snapshot owner data frontier, V2-only product attachment, and prevention of legacy helper downgrade. The canonical crate is the one-peer checked engine; <=16-peer discovery/aggregation is product-orchestrator policy. Current V2 contracts are in-process Rust contracts, not an authenticated cross-host wire protocol. Physical-send final revalidation batches each owner/capability attachment set through one owner SQLite snapshot under one total bounded deadline; both direct federated and combined contributors delegate to that same batch path. The local observed_frontier is the exact-scope append-only memory-revision count from the retrieval snapshot; it is not an authenticated cut digest or rollback witness. The canonical implementation-profile claim state remains specified_not_product_evidence until execution gates pass. productExecutionProved, productionImplementation, activation, acceptance, promotion and release remain false until their independent evidence gates pass.
